reviews.comment:
El combustible más caro que en las otras estaciones, la atención de los bacheros apurados como que quieren cargarte y que te vayas. Los baños cerrados únicamente el de discapacitados será para limpiar menos. Para controlar el aire tenes que tener aprobado el cursillo de submarinista!!!

(Translated by Google)
The fuel is more expensive than at other stations, and the attendants are rushed, like they just want to fill up your tank and get you out of here. The restrooms are closed except for the accessible one—probably because they don't clean them as often. To check the air supply, you need to have passed a scuba diving course!
